_comment: Seed dataset for Layer 1 (silicon spec) analysis — base/boost clock and TDP are manufacturer-published facts, verified against vendor spec pages / TechSpot / Intel ARK at the time each entry was added, not estimated. match_key is matched as a lowercased substring against the CPUID brand string. A CPU not found here degrades to a lower-confidence heuristic finding rather than blocking analysis — see analysis::stress_findings.

cpus.source: Intel ARK, verified 2026-08 (28W base-power SKU variant)
